name: GitHub REST API
tagline: Programmatic access to repositories, issues, PRs, users, and GitHub platform data.
description: Official REST API for GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise. Authenticate with personal access tokens, GitHub Apps, or OAuth; list and manage repos, issues, pull requests, workflows, users, orgs, and more. Responses are JSON over HTTPS at api.github.com with documented rate limits and media types.

auth.details: Bearer token via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN (classic/fine-grained PAT, GitHub App installation token, or OAuth access token). Unauthenticated requests allowed with very low rate limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with free GitHub accounts; primary cost is rate limits (see rate_limits), not per-request fees
pricing.paid_plans: Paid GitHub plans (Pro, Team, Enterprise) raise some product limits; API itself has no separate per-call pricing on github.com

rate_limits: Authenticated (PAT/OAuth/App user-to-server): 5,000 req/hour primary; GitHub App installation: up to 15,000 req/hour (scales with seats for Enterprise). Unauthenticated: 60 req/hour per IP. Secondary limits and GraphQL point costs also apply.
use_cases: list open issues or PRs on a repository
get repository metadata, stars, and default branch
create or update an issue comment from an automation
fetch a user's public profile and repositories
check workflow run status for a CI integration
search code or repositories across GitHub
